description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Kalshi prediction-market probabilities. Query by category (returns the most active open markets) or a specific market ticker.

**Example:** `/v1/kalshi-probability?category=crypto`

Use when you want live Kalshi prediction-market probabilities by category or ticker. Not for a single market's depth (use kalshi_market) or Polymarket (use polymarket).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

category.description: Optional. One of: crypto, macro, fed-rate, financials, politics, sports, world, companies, climate, science, health, entertainment, elections. Either category or ticker is required.

limit.description: Optional. Max markets to return for a category query (default 25, max 100).

ticker.description: Optional. A specific Kalshi market ticker (e.g. KXBTCD-...).

name: kalshi_probability
